source.author: lucan
source.text: Cyniphias inter pestes tibi palma nocendi est; Eripiunt omnes animam, tu sola cadaver.
source.text_original: Cyniphias inter pestes tibi palma nocendi est; / Eripiunt omnes animam, tu sola cadaver.
source.text_english: Among the Libyan plagues, the palm of harming belongs to you; all others snatch away the life, you alone the corpse.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin rapis hine animam et famulos citus effugis artus?
reuse.text_original: quin rapis hine animam et famulos citus effugis artus?
reuse.text_english: Why do you not snatch your soul from here and quickly escape your enslaved limbs?
